name: The Mask Game
source:
A group of friends (and one uninvited interloper) put their bonds to the test by performing an arcane ritual in a basement on Halloween. What could go wrong?

This is a short, completely standalone side story set in an alternate timeline of the game R. I. P. Tour.
translation:
一群朋友（和一个不速之客）在万圣节在地下室举行了一个神秘的仪式，以考验他们的关系。可能会出什么问题？

这是一个简短、完全独立的支线故事，背景设定在游戏R.I.P. Tour的另一个时间线上。
